This implies that edoxaban may modulate inflammatory signaling through the Caspase-14-Pregnenolone-SLC1B3 axis. The presence of a final score of 0.56 suggests some level of confidence in this relationship, though further validation is needed. The mechanism appears to involve a cascade where edoxaban influences inflammatory pathways, potentially affecting the function of SLC1B3, which is involved in the transport of organic anions.
